nodes.description: address public owner; privileged address of the Ownable contract, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor and writable via transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
address public master; receives the planet purchase price via master.transfer(price) in buy_planet.
bool public inited; guards the one-time planet seeding in init().
uint256 public koef; global divisor applied to all prices and fees, owner-controlled via set_koef.
bool private create_flag; toggled on every buy_planet to decide whether three new planets are minted.
uint256 public silo; accumulated FEE_SILO pot paid out to the previous silo holder.
address public silo_addr; current holder of the silo pot.
uint256 public silo_timer; initialised with now (block.timestamp) and extended by TIMER_STEP, drives the silo countdown.
mapping(address => Player) players; holds per-account balance, position, state, discount and owned planet ids.
Node[] public nodes; circular doubly-linked list of Planet records (fee, data, owner, prev, next).
uint256 public constant PLANET_PRICE = 100000000000000000; base price of a planet.
uint256 public constant FEE_SILO = 10000000000000000; amount added to the silo on each purchase.
uint256 public constant FEE_RANGE = 29000000000000000; range used when pseudo-randomly deriving a planet fee.
uint256 public constant FEE_MIN = 5000000000000000; minimum randomly derived planet fee.
uint256 public constant TIMER_STEP = 120; seconds added to silo_timer per purchase.
uint256 public constant PAGE_SIZE = 25; page size for get_owner_planets pagination.
constructor() public of Ownable; sets owner = msg.sender.
modifier onlyOwner(); require(msg.sender == owner), the sole access-control primitive of the contract.
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner; emits OwnershipRenounced and sets owner to address(0).
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership(address _newOwner) internal; requires non-zero address and writes owner = _newOwner.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 _a, uint256 _b); guarded multiplication with assert(c / _a == _b).
SafeMath.div(uint256 _a, uint256 _b); unchecked division (Solidity reverts on division by zero).
SafeMath.sub(uint256 _a, uint256 _b); assert(_b <= _a) then subtraction.
SafeMath.add(uint256 _a, uint256 _b); addition with assert(c >= _a) overflow check.
constructor(address addr) public; stores the privileged payout address into master.
init() public onlyOwner; seeds twelve planets once and sets inited = true.
function() public payable; payable fallback that forwards all value to buy_spice_melange().
get_owner_planets(uint256 page) external view; paginated view over players[msg.sender].planets.
set_master(address adr) public onlyOwner; rewrites the payout address master.
set_koef(uint256 _koef) public onlyOwner; rewrites the global price divisor koef.
get_planet_price() public view; returns PLANET_PRICE/koef + FEE_SILO/koef.
get_planet_info(uint id) external view; returns a node's fee, data, owner, prev and next.
get_info(uint256 id) public view; walks twelve nodes and reports the silo state (uses block.timestamp).
get_player_state() external view; returns balance, position, state, discount, computed planet price and owned count.
create_planet() private; derives a pseudo-random fee from blockhash/msg.sender and inserts a new Planet node.
buy_spice_melange() public payable; credits msg.value to players[msg.sender].balance and initialises the player position.
sell_spice_melange(uint256 amount) public; subtracts from balance then performs msg.sender.send(amount) before any further bookkeeping.
move() public; walks the linked list inside an unbounded while(true) loop paying fees to other planet owners.
step() public; single-step variant of move().
buy_planet() public; charges the price, mints planets, manages the silo and finally calls master.transfer(price).
get_len() external view; returns nodes.length.
insert(Planet planet, uint256 prev) private; splices a new node into the circular list and returns its index.
msg.sender; drives ownership assignment, mapping lookups, address(this) checks and the onlyOwner guard.
tx.origin; used as the anti-contract gate (require(msg.sender == tx.origin)) in every state-changing game function.
block.timestamp (now); initialises silo_timer, extends it by TIMER_STEP and is compared in buy_planet/get_info.
msg.sender.send(amount) in sell_spice_melange: unchecked low-level call forwarding ether to an arbitrary caller-chosen address.
master.transfer(price) in buy_planet: value-bearing external call executed at the end of the function.
while(true) loop in move(): unbounded iteration over the linked list, gas/DoS risk when many neighbouring planets are owned.
Raw pre-0.8 arithmetic (accounting, fees, silo, discounts) whose correctness depends entirely on SafeMath usage (mul/div/sub/add).
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership; target of the ownership reassignment.
Parameter _a of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter _b of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter _a of SafeMath.div.
Parameter _b of SafeMath.div.
Parameter _a of SafeMath.sub.
Parameter _b of SafeMath.sub.
Parameter _a of SafeMath.add.
Parameter _b of SafeMath.add.
Parameter addr of the CHOAM constructor; becomes master, the privileged recipient.
Parameter page of get_owner_planets; multiplied by PAGE_SIZE to offset the iteration.
Parameter adr of set_master; assigned to master.
Parameter _koef of set_koef; assigned to koef.
Parameter id of get_planet_info; unchecked index into nodes.
Parameter id of get_info; starting index for the node walk.
Parameter amount of sell_spice_melange; amount credited back to msg.sender via send.
Parameter planet of the private insert function.
Parameter prev of insert; list index used for splicing the new node.
Local c in SafeMath.mul; product that is asserted against overflow.
Local hash in create_planet; keccak256 over blockhash, msg.sender and nodes.length.
Local fee in create_planet; derived from hash modulo FEE_RANGE plus FEE_MIN.
Local id in create_planet; insertion index derived from hash modulo nodes.length.
Local id in move; cursor over the linked list inside the while(true) loop.
Local id in step; single cursor advance.
Local price in buy_planet; discounted planet price plus silo fee.
Local id in buy_planet; the planet being purchased.
Local node in insert; memory Node pushed into the nodes array.
Local tmp in get_owner_planets; planet index read from the caller's planet array.
Local start in get_owner_planets; page * PAGE_SIZE offset.
Local hash in buy_spice_melange; pseudo-random source for the initial player position.
Local fee in move; per-node fee charged to the moving player.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner in the Ownable constructor.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner; the whole privileged surface depends on this check.
msg.sender is the key used for every players mapping read/write.
buy_spice_melange requires msg.sender == tx.origin as its anti-contract gate.
sell_spice_melange requires msg.sender == tx.origin, so any contract-originated call is rejected.
move() gates execution on tx.origin.
step() gates execution on tx.origin.
buy_planet() gates execution on tx.origin, a fragile anti-bot heuristic.
silo_timer is initialised with now (block.timestamp).
buy_planet branches on now < silo_timer and extends silo_timer by TIMER_STEP; minable timestamp dependency.
get_info exposes silo_timer - now, leaking the timestamp-dependent countdown.
set_master is guarded by onlyOwner.
set_koef is guarded by onlyOwner.
init is guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership calls into _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the privileged owner slot from a caller-supplied address.
The payable fallback forwards every plain ether transfer into buy_spice_melange.
init calls create_planet twelve times to seed the world.
buy_planet mints three new planets whenever create_flag is already set.
create_planet delegates list mutation to insert.
insert pushes the new Node into the nodes array and rewires prev/next pointers.
move executes an unbounded while(true) walk over the linked list.
move reads nodes[id].next and nodes[id].planet fields while iterating.
step reads nodes[id].next/owner/fee for a single hop.
sell_spice_melange performs msg.sender.send(amount) to an arbitrary address supplied by the caller.
The low-level send hands control to msg.sender before the function fully settles, enabling re-entry into the game.
buy_planet ends with master.transfer(price), an external value-bearing call.
The transfer to master hands control to an external address while silo/balance state has just been rewritten.
SafeMath.mul is the overflow barrier for all multiplicative accounting.
SafeMath.div performs fee/price division that depends on koef and discount values.
SafeMath.sub guards all balance debits.
SafeMath.add guards all balance, silo and timer credits.
buy_planet computes price = PLANET_PRICE/koef - discount% + FEE_SILO/koef and mutates balances and silo.
move subtracts fees from the mover and adds them to the planet owner without any re-entrancy guard.
buy_spice_melange credits msg.value into players[msg.sender].balance.
sell_spice_melange debits players[msg.sender].balance before sending ether out.
buy_planet updates the caller's balance, planet list and discount, and credits the previous silo holder.
buy_planet resets or accumulates the silo pot (silo = FEE_SILO or silo.add(FEE_SILO)).
buy_planet reassigns silo_addr to msg.sender.
buy_planet rewrites silo_timer using now and TIMER_STEP.
buy_planet toggles create_flag to alternate planet-minting batches.
get_owner_planets reads players[msg.sender].planets with a page offset.
get_player_state reads the caller's Player struct fields.
get_info walks twelve nodes starting from the caller-supplied id without bounds checking.
get_planet_info indexes nodes[id] directly with an unvalidated id.
get_planet_price divides PLANET_PRICE and FEE_SILO by the owner-controlled koef.
set_master overwrites the payout address master.
set_koef overwrites the global price divisor koef.
init sets inited = true even if the seeding loop was skipped.
The caller-controlled amount determines how much ether is pushed out by send before bookkeeping completes.
adr becomes the new master, the recipient of every purchase price.
_koef becomes the global divisor and is only checked to be > 0.
Constructor addr is stored into master and can later be rewritten by set_master.
_newOwner is validated as non-zero and then written into owner.
page is multiplied by PAGE_SIZE to offset the read loop.
id indexes nodes without a bounds check in get_planet_info.
id is the starting cursor for the get_info linked-list walk.
planet is the payload stored in the freshly inserted node.
prev determines where the new node is spliced into the circular list.
Multiplicand _a feeds the guarded product in mul.
Multiplier _b feeds the guarded product in mul.
Numerator _a of div.
Denominator _b of div; zero denominator reverts.
Minuend _a of sub.
Subtrahend _b of sub, asserted to be <= _a.
First addend _a of add.
Second addend _b of add, asserted not to overflow.
Local c holds the product that is verified with assert(c / _a == _b).
hash in create_planet is reused both as the fee entropy and as the Planet data field.
fee in create_planet is stored on the new Planet node.
id in create_planet selects the insertion point in the circular list.
id in move tracks the caller's cursor and is written back into players[msg.sender].position.
id in step tracks a single cursor advance.
price in buy_planet is compared against balance and then transferred to master.
id in buy_planet is the planet being claimed and pushed into the player's list.
node in insert is the memory struct pushed onto the nodes array.
tmp is the planet index used to resolve nodes[tmp].planet.fee.
start is page.mul(PAGE_SIZE) and offsets the planet loop.
hash in buy_spice_melange derives the player's initial list position from block entropy.
fee in move is subtracted from the mover and added to the planet owner each iteration.
